comparison: The J-fiber call targets the sufficient whole actual weighted diagonal sum_s w(s)P_s^2=O(p^(3/2)) through the paired-map invariant of Round 179. The mixed-row call targets the weighted slope-product term of the right energy E(mu) of Round 178, which enters the separate one-match criterion for H_alpha, not the diagonal. Both belong to the ordinary positive-completion route, but neither estimate implies the other at the stated scales, so they were reviewed as independent. The cold call concerns coordinate confinement of the marked Picard prefix on the original square and shares no estimate with the ordinary calls. No earlier call is active.
